proof_body:
by
  intro p
  have hL : MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun x : ℝ => x) 2 (ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure (1 : ℝ) 0 p) := by
    refine (MeasureTheory.memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (f := fun x : ℝ => x) measurable_id.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr ?_
    exact ProbabilityTheory.integrable_bernoulliMeasure 1 0 p _
  have h1 : ∫ x, x ∂(ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure (1 : ℝ) 0 p) = (p : ℝ) := by
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.integral_bernoulliMeasure]; simp
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  rw [ProbabilityTheory.variance_eq_sub hL]
  simp only [Pi.pow_apply]
  rw [h1, ProbabilityTheory.integral_bernoulliMeasure]
  simp
  ring
target_source: ∀ p : unitInterval, ∫ x, x ∂(ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure (1 : ℝ) 0 p) = (p : ℝ) ∧ ProbabilityTheory.variance (fun x : ℝ => x) (ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure (1 : ℝ) 0 p) = (p : ℝ) * (1 - (p : ℝ))
